data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2023 gross claims outstanding were GBP 3,045.2m. During 2023 gross prior-period reserves reduced by GBP 1,271.2m (a release of c.41.7% of opening gross reserves), largely reflecting favorable prior-year development and the impact of RITC/portfolio transfers alongside a comparatively benign catastrophe year and favourable non-cat current accident year performance. The net narrative cites a GBP 25.3m net prior period reserve reduction; however the gross movement in the insurance liabilities column was a GBP 1,271.2m release. The Russia-Ukraine exposure remains reserved (GBP 166.6m gross), and 2022 catastrophe events (Australian floods, Hurricane Ian) materially impacted prior year loss experience.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement taken from note 12(a) 'Movements arising from prior year claims' (Insurance liabilities column = GBP (1,271.2)m) and opening gross claims from the Statement of Financial Position (prior-year comparative = GBP 3,045.2m). Narrative statements quoting a GBP 25.3m movement are NET figures; both gross (note) and net (narrative) are present. The 2023 RiverStone RITC transactions materially distort comparatives and balance sheet movements (removal/extinguishment of 2018 & prior reserves); this may affect direct interpretation at underwriting-year granularity. Per-LOB gross prior-year reserve movements are not explicitly disclosed and have been inferred as overall release; amounts per LOB are therefore null.
